build_optimizer_with_scheduler: build an AdamW optimizer with a configurable learning rate scheduler for a PyTorch model
build_lr_fn_cosine: build a cosine learning rate schedule function with warmup and configurable cycle length
build_lr_fn_wsd: build a warmup-stable-decay learning rate schedule function based on the river valley loss landscape paper
create_OptimArgs_dataclass: create an OptimArgs dataclass to configure optimizer hyperparameters like lr, weight decay, and scheduler type
test_lr_schedulers: test the linear, inverse square root, cosine, and wsd learning rate scheduler functions
